title: A day at the market
somali: Subaxnimadii Sabtida, Aamina waxay hooyadeed ula tagtaa suuqa. Suuqu waa mashquul badan yahay oo buuq badan. Miis kasta oo wax lagu iibiyo wuxuu iibiyaa alaab ka duwan kuwa kale. Aamina waxay jeceshahay meesha miraha lagu iibiyo, sababtoo ah liimuhu waa cusub yihiin oo macaan yihiin. Hooyadeed waxay jeceshahay gorgortanka, sidaas darteed waxay codsataa in qiimaha laga dhimo. Waxay iibsadaan liimo, bariis iyo rooti, dabadeedna guriga ayay ku noqdaan ka hor duhurkii.
explanation: On Saturday morning, Amina goes to the market with her mother. The market is busy and noisy. Every stall sells something different. Amina likes the fruit stall because the oranges are fresh and sweet. Her mother likes to bargain, so she asks for a lower price. They buy oranges, rice and bread, and they go home before noon.
examples: stall: a small table or shop where things are sold in a market
bargain: to talk about the price to try to make it lower

title: Working from home
somali: Dad badan ayaa hadda guriga ka shaqeeya ugu yaraan maalmo ka mid ah toddobaadka. Faa’iidada ugu weyn waa in jadwalku dabacsanaan karo: waxaad shaqada bilaabi kartaa goor hore ama nasasho qaadan kartaa marka aad u baahato. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhibaatooyin ayaa iyaguna jira. Marka guriga la joogo, waxyaabaha mashquuliya sida telefishinka ama qol aan hagaagsanayn waxay adkayn karaan in qofku diiradda saaro. Dadka si guul leh meel fog uga shaqeeya badanaa waxay samaystaan nidaam joogto ah, saacado shaqo oo go’an iyo meel deggan oo ay ka shaqeeyaan.
explanation: Many people now work from home at least some days of the week. The main advantage is that the schedule can be flexible: you can start early or take a break when you need one. However, there are also problems. At home, a distraction such as the television or a messy room can make it hard to focus. Successful remote workers usually build a routine, with fixed hours and a quiet place to work.
examples: distraction: something that stops you from paying attention
routine: the usual order in which you do things

exercises.explain: The text says the schedule can be flexible.
exercises.promptSo: Waa maxay hal faa’iido oo qoraalka lagu xusay?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Jadwal dabacsan”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: What can make it hard to focus?
exercises.explain: A distraction such as the television can make it hard to focus.
exercises.promptSo: Maxaa qofka ku adkayn kara inuu feejignaado?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Wax guriga ka mashquuliya”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

exercises.prompt: What do successful remote workers usually build?
exercises.promptSo: Shaqaalaha meel fog ka shaqeeya ee guulaysta maxay badanaa samaystaan?
exercises.explainSo: Jawaabta saxda ahi waa “Hab-raac joogto ah”. Ka raadi qoraalka jumladda taageeraysa jawaabtan, hana ku salayn qiyaas.

examplesSo: dabacsan: si fudud wax looga beddeli karo
wax mashquuliya: shay kaa jeediya waxa aad fiiro u leedahay
nidaam joogto ah: habka caadiga ah ee hawlaha loo kala qabto
